primary.title: From credit score impact to financial burden, 5 loan risks every borrower and guarantor should know
primary.summary: A simple favour can lead to lasting costs. Understanding the risks of loan guarantorship helps protect your credit score, assets, and finances before agreeing to support a personal loan application. If in doubt, do not hesitate to take professional guidance before agreeing to a loan guarantor.
